intro.text: A nation known for its spicy cooking and a major exporter of spices such as RaiDel peppers.
A nation under Fjordell rule, known for its spicy cooking and a major exporter of spices such as RaiDel peppers.

description.text: The JinDo eat with MaiPon sticks and take a strict view of health: being overweight is frowned upon, even though some JinDo dishes, such as HaiKo, are greasy.
JinDo people are dark brown of skin, with fine features. The people of Jaador are ethnically JinDo, and the Dula descend from both JinDo and Aonic stock.
ChayShan, a meditative martial art that helps practitioners focus the mind, comes from JinDo.
The work of JinDo philosophers, mathematicians and artists is famous abroad. One such artist, Atsuko, once visited the Rose Empire.

items.text: Following Shu-Keseg, which values peace, openness and unity through acceptance, the JinDo chose not to fight when the Fjordell Empire spread. They accepted Fjordell rule and outwardly converted to Shu-Dereth.
